notes: OUTCOME, review note 1 is answered: in render.js, draw now loops over the towers twice. It calls drawLanternLight for every lantern, then drawHover, then drawLanternBody, so no lantern's light pool can paint over an earlier lantern's body or the hover highlight. The render test 'every light pool is drawn before the hover cell and before any lantern body' checks this order with a fake context that records every call.

OUTCOME, review note 2 is answered: render.js no longer exports PALETTE, and THEME in src/theme.js is the only colour name. test/enemy.test.js now reads THEME, and render.test.js checks that render.js has no hex or rgba literal, exports no PALETTE, and that every colour draw sets is a THEME value.

OUTCOME, issue #3 is met. createGame adds status, wave 1, totalWaves (default 5) and stored options. step sets 'lost' as soon as lives reach 0, before any shooting or wave counting, so a round that loses its last life on the final wave is still lost. It sets 'won' only when the last wave is cleared, does nothing once the round is over, and restart(state) builds a new game from the stored options. render.js draws both end messages and 'Click to play again', and main.js now holds the game in a `let` and calls restart on a click once the round is over. game-over.test.js tests each acceptance item, including the case where the last life and the last wave go on the same step.

OUTCOME, issue #4 is met. drawLantern draws a radial-gradient pool and a rounded, ribbed body under a cap. drawGhost draws an arc head with a curved wavy hem and two eye ellipses, and draws a full health bar when the ghost has no maxHealth. drawBeam draws a glow stroke with shadowBlur 12, then resets it to 0 inside save/restore. drawPath draws edge and stone strokes over alternating grass tiles. draw reaches the sprites through a SPRITES table that a test can replace, which proves drawPath runs once and drawGhost never runs on a fresh game.

CONSTRUCTION: I found no defect. The step that loses the round returns before shots and towers update, so nothing changes after the loss. The win check only runs when lives are above 0. restart leaves the finished game unchanged. The end screen only reads state.
